snapshot_restore_contract.actuator_state: tensor/scalar state plus nested delay/circular buffers
snapshot_restore_contract.sensor_data_access: cached _data; no lazy sensor update during capture/restore
snapshot_restore_contract.backend_target_restore: direct PhysX setters, without an extra actuator/delay-buffer tick
snapshot_restore_contract.physx_contact_solver_cache: not exposed by the Python snapshot API; replay checks remain required

physics_substep_comparison.torque_note: applied/computed torque is telemetry; implicit actuator telemetry does not establish the solver's actual joint effort
physics_substep_comparison.scope: first control step only; unobserved simulator state is not proven equal by these fields

collection_audit_contract.fault_parameter_note: planned values; interpret only for the matching fault kind
collection_audit_contract.fault_start_in_s: relative to the last observed sensor frame; negative means already started
collection_audit_contract.first_failure_cause_stable: first-step bitmask agrees between repeated branch rollouts
collection_audit_contract.candidate_safety_note: ground truth at candidate time; audit only
collection_audit_contract.group_ids_meaning: terrain seed/type/level group, not episode identity
collection_audit_contract.scenario_seed_meaning: candidate row ID, not fault event identity

noise_audit_contract.scope: audit only, excluded from selector features
noise_audit_contract.fault_event: parent event includes bursts, gaps, corrections and residual cells

directed_audit_contract.clean_label_window: no injected fault in observable history or label window; current data available
directed_audit_contract.severity: per branch; legacy plan severity is the maximum for independent dual events
directed_audit_contract.scope: audit and admission only; excluded from all selector features
directed_audit_contract.vp_model: input-level surrogate on captured depth in metres; not a camera renderer
directed_audit_contract.mask_centers: normalized image coordinates at parent start; motion uses direction, speed and event age
directed_audit_contract.recovery_effect: includes corrupted images remaining in VP/selector history; fully clean history is ineligible
directed_audit_contract.history_interval_s: newer delivered source timestamp minus previous; can be negative for reordered arrivals

filter_contract.pair_acceptance: both LP and VP satisfy all hard conditions
filter_contract.audit_value_source: second replay; time and cause differences do not reject valid agreeing labels
filter_contract.legacy_comparison: strict timing gate: legacy discrete fields equal and both outcomes valid
filter_contract.both_replays_valid_scope: all four LP/VP rollouts, before scenario quotas

per_candidate_replay_diagnostics.eligible_scope: same rows as per_candidate_replay_filter.checked, before outcome-validity filtering
per_candidate_replay_diagnostics.retained_scope: eligible rows passing the new replay gate, before scenario quotas; written counters apply quotas
per_candidate_replay_diagnostics.diagnostic_label_note: second-replay labels classify rejected rows; they are not reliable ground truth

collection_audit.observed_plan_scope: from collection start through real behavior steps; excludes burn-in and all counterfactual/replay forks
collection_audit.pre_replay_pair_note: diagnostic second-replay labels, not reliable ground truth for rejected pairs

source_acceptance.scope: initially safe, observable, valid and replay-stable candidate pairs, before quotas
source_acceptance.quota_rejected_scope: rows visited before the time budget or target stopped admission

temporal_coverage.stage_counter_scope: label-attempt snapshots; excludes burn-in and unsampled 10 Hz ticks
temporal_coverage.note: Pacing is an upper admission bound. Stage counters are diagnostic, not outcome quotas or proof of stage coverage.
